mapper.select: UPDATE auth_governance.projection_stream SET worker_id=#{worker},lease_generation=lease_generation+1, lease_until=clock_timestamp()+interval '15 seconds',updated_at=clock_timestamp() WHERE fence_id=#{id} AND lease_until <=clock_timestamp() AND next_attempt_at <=clock_timestamp() AND failures < 5 RETURNING

SELECT FROM auth_governance.projection_stream WHERE fence_id=#{lease.fenceId} AND worker_id=#{lease.workerId} AND lease_generation=#{lease.leaseGeneration} AND lease_until >clock_timestamp() FOR UPDATE
SELECT FROM auth_governance.projection_operation WHERE fence_id=#{id} AND state='PENDING'
SELECT FROM auth_governance.projection_operation WHERE fence_id=#{fence} AND id=#{id}

SELECT gm.id,gm.group_id,gm.membership_id,gm.generation, (gm.current AND dg.active AND NOT src.quarantined AND src.business_zone IS NOT NULL AND m.generation=gm.generation AND m.status='ACTIVE' AND u.status='ACTIVE' AND t.status='ACTIVE') present FROM auth_governance.directory_group_member gm JOIN auth_governance.directory_group dg ON dg.id=gm.group_id JOIN auth_governance.directory_source src ON src.id=dg.source_id JOIN auth_governance.membership m ON m.id=gm.membership_id JOIN auth_governance.principal u ON u.id=m.principal_id JOIN auth_governance.tenant t ON t.id=gm.tenant_id WHERE gm.tenant_id=#{t.partition.tenantId} AND gm.id >#{after} ORDER BY gm.id LIMIT 51
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO auth_governance.projection_grant_receipt(grant_id,grant_version,operation_id) VALUES(#{g.id},#{g.version},#{operation}) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING
mapper.update: UPDATE auth_governance.projection_stream SET batch_counter=batch_counter+1 WHERE fence_id=#{id} AND batch_counter=#{before}
UPDATE auth_governance.projection_operation SET state='SUPERSEDED' WHERE id=#{id} AND state='PENDING'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO auth_governance.projection_receipt(operation_id,graph_marker,content_hash,zed_token,confirmed_by) VALUES(#{o.id},#{o.id},#{o.contentHash},#{token},#{worker}) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING
mapper.update: UPDATE auth_governance.projection_operation SET state='APPLIED' WHERE id=#{id} AND state IN ('PENDING','SUPERSEDED')
UPDATE auth_governance.access_grant SET state='ACTIVE',zed_token=#{token},updated_at=clock_timestamp() WHERE id=#{g.id} AND version=#{g.version} AND state='PENDING'
UPDATE auth_governance.grant_projection SET completed=true,last_error=NULL WHERE grant_id=#{g.id} AND grant_version <= #{g.version} AND completed=false

UPDATE SET applied_epoch=#{o.targetEpoch},state='READY',zed_token=#{token},updated_at=clock_timestamp() WHERE id=#{t.fenceId} AND desired_epoch=#{o.targetEpoch} AND state <> 'BLOCKED' AND #{o.lastBatch}=true
UPDATE auth_governance.projection_operation SET attempts=attempts+1 WHERE fence_id=#{id} AND state='PENDING'

UPDATE auth_governance.projection_stream SET failures=0,next_attempt_at=clock_timestamp(),updated_at=clock_timestamp() WHERE fence_id=#{lease.fenceId} AND worker_id=#{lease.workerId} AND lease_generation=#{lease.leaseGeneration} AND lease_until >clock_timestamp() AND failures > 0

UPDATE auth_governance.projection_stream SET failures=least(5,failures+1), next_attempt_at=clock_timestamp()+make_interval(secs => least(60,power(2,failures+1)::integer) + random()),updated_at=clock_timestamp() WHERE fence_id=#{lease.fenceId} AND worker_id=#{lease.workerId} AND lease_generation=#{lease.leaseGeneration} AND lease_until >clock_timestamp()
UPDATE auth_governance.projection_stream SET lease_until=clock_timestamp() WHERE fence_id=#{lease.fenceId} AND worker_id=#{lease.workerId} AND lease_generation=#{lease.leaseGeneration}
